# Changelog
- [2026-05-18] `dev`, `angular-front` — Refined the shared `app-ds-autocomplete` overlay contract: removed the `panelWidth="auto"` override so Material keeps the panel aligned to the full trigger width, kept the empty/loading copy block non-growing so the state icon stays visually centered, and revalidated the focused DS autocomplete spec plus frontend typecheck/build.
- [2026-05-18] `dev` — Fixed repository-scoped PAT diagnostics end-to-end: the generate layout now reads API `Errors[0].Description` for PAT-save and repo-connection failures, the PAT dialog shows the backend reason instead of a generic modal error, and `KeyVaultSecretClient.SetSecretAsync(...)` logs Azure failures while mapping write issues to the dedicated `GitRepository.SecretStorageFailed` message; focused Angular specs, frontend typecheck, and a new infrastructure Key Vault test are green.
- [2026-05-18] `dev`, `angular-front` — Fixed the global sidebar favorites source: the shell now loads projects and derives `Favoris` from the actual favorite project ids instead of filtering the recent-items list, so favorites remain visible even when they were not opened recently; focused sidebar spec, frontend typecheck, and frontend build are green.
- [2026-05-18] `dev`, `angular-front` — Fixed the Home dashboard Favorites overflow: the two-column grid now uses shrinkable `minmax(0, 1fr)` tracks and `dashboard-panel` applies `min-width: 0`, preventing long project descriptions from pushing the Favorites panel into the Recent section; focused Home spec stayed green, while the frontend production build remains blocked by unrelated existing TypeScript errors in `layout-repositories` / `project-git-pat-dialog`.
- [2026-05-18] `dev`, `dotnet-dev`, `angular-front` — Restored project repository Git UX on `/projects/:id/generate`: reintroduced explicit shared PAT configuration via `PUT /projects/{id}/git-pat`, added per-repository connection testing via `POST /projects/{id}/repositories/{repoId}/test-connection`, and fixed the locked-slot repository dialog so `AllInOne` / `SplitInfraCode` render read-only content-kind summaries instead of misleading editable choices; focused backend tests, frontend specs, typecheck, and frontend build were revalidated.
- [2026-05-18] `dev`, `angular-front` — Fixed the new DS autocomplete overlay alignment: the trigger now spans the full field width with overlaid prefix/suffix affordances, and the empty/loading state content is vertically centered so the panel matches the search field visually.
